scope: motorized traffic only; actual pedestrian service remains outside this baseline until observed plans/counts are supplied
demand: source class totals at 100%; optional ST50 cases use scale 0.5 because PDF p.73 says the source simulations halved recorded demand
geometry: J1 and J3 physical junction nodes explicitly merged using netconvert; J2's staggered F. Mendoza junction retained
signal_cycle: conditional candidate C=G+Y+R from the source's representative signal summary; not an observed full phase plan
green_splits: fixed per AM/PM window, proportional to planned approach volume per motor lane with 10 s minimum; no online adaptation
phase_order: netconvert incoming-arm protected order; unused nonmotor-only OSM branch stages excluded from the motor-only reference
clearance: 4 s yellow from source summaries; 4 s all-red assumed and simulation checked, not field approved
offsets: zero offset; no observed coordination data available
isolated_demand: same planned movement/class visits and source departure schedule as corridor canonical trips; boundary times are assumed, not measured arrivals
vehicle_model: LC2013, lane-based; motorcycle filtering NOT represented or field calibrated
drain: input ends at 4200 s; run to 14400 s to expose residual deadlocks and report clearance separately from study-hour throughput
safeguards: no teleport/removal shortcuts; junction collision checks enabled; minGap collision threshold left at default
field_validation_missing: complete observed phase programs and offsets
